about.text: A mixture of milk and cream with at least 10.5 % and less than 18 % milkfat, poured into coffee in the United States.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream and milk are blended to the fat grade (10.5 to under 18 %) and heat-treated; nothing is soured or cultured. The figures are the US legal definition.
